chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't bhiogi' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Bet-leem gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu u'vɨ gook gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't gu Elimelek gu u'vɨ gu Noemi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Maaloon gu Kelioon gu Eprateos gu Bet-leem gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam gu Moab guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Elimelek gu chio'ñ gu Noemi guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx gook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' gu u'vɨ gu Moab gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Orpa gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Rut; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koko' gio gook gu Maaloon gu Kelioon guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gook gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak ja'tkam gu Moab; na gu' jix kai yooxi' gu Moab gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam na ba' jix duu gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix buus pai' ka't dhi' bɨɨx gook tu jiim kua'da' jiim na ba' jix joi'ñ gu oidha' gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Noemi gook tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu naan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx koko'kam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu chio'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨndak gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Noemi jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam no'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam vook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨpna'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' nɨɨra no'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu tukaa' jum duu bɨɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' dua'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm bhaai'n guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam cham ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga no'ñ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu'.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Orpa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bakxidhat gu' gu Rut guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Noemi; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jir bɨx bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Rut jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dɨlhkob tu'; na gu' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' tu jiim jix duu tu'; jano' ba' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu duaka'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ka't gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' tu' vaak jodai koi tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ koi'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Noemi ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ñiokda'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gook bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bet-leem; gio ba' ka't baakɨk gu Bet-leem bɨx kiicham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Noemi.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Noemi guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mɨmɨim gu Mara; na gu' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mɨmɨim gu Noemi tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa chuut bhaan tu' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Noemi gu Rut gu Moabita guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak ja'tkam gu Moab guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bet-leem gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' kai' vaas.
Jano' ba' gu Teniia gu Noemi jir bɨx bhai' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ja'tkam vaak gu Elimelek guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Boos.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rut gu Moabita gu Noemi; gio ba' gu Rueegote guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' yooxi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kaipgaidhat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr gu vupui bakia' nɨidhidha'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam yooxi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam yooxi' ka't gu Boos ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Elimelek.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Boos suudai' u'va gu Bet-leem guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Boos jix duu daam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu daam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Moab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Noemi vaak ja'tkam gu Moab.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui dɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm jano' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Boos gu Rut; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam yooxi' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr dhi' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam yooxi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu suudai' jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vupui guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' kai'ch:―Dho gu Boos; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx bakxidhat mi' dhɨr koi'm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu taat gu naan gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨbiap gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn va'k.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu duukam tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tɨbiap na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam na tu juan cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Boos gu tas jugi; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chin jɨ'ɨɨk; mi' dhɨr jix daa ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix maa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix jugi bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix búup na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu Boos jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gio kaipgaidhat tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' va'k guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't na ja'p gu Epa kai' vaas.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ suudai' u'va kiicham; gio ba' bakxidhat jix ñi' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix buusñi gio ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' bakxidhat; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ duukat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr jix duu bakxidhat ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Boos.

Ba' jix aa' gu Noemi guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ko'iix guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Noemi; jano' ba' chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rut gu Moabita; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook bɨx oraa'.

Jano' ba' gu Noemi jix aa' gu Rut guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' tutkɨ mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi'.

Jano' ba' juruuñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Boos guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm oraa' kai' vaas guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' bɨɨx bakxidhat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Diijole bakxidhat gu Noemi; gio ba' mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' ka't jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu Boos chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' dhi' gu Miren guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kai' vaas.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't; gu' cham tu' maa'n jix maati' gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook jugi i'i.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨɨt tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix dhaav ka't tu' bɨx bakxidhat ka't.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Boos ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ juruuñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim koox guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gɨ' kavɨk; gio ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ñi'ñ tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ka't ɨraab gu tukaa' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Rut ja'tkam na tu juan; na gu' muuk jannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan ja'tkam na tu juan na gu' jix duu jir bɨx bhai' mia'n.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tutkɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam nɨidhidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham jiimchu' bhaan biipibop ka't bia' chutumñigam.

Jano' ba' jano' cham jum i'obh mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨndak tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx ki'ñgob gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨɨda' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' mia'n bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham tu'x jai'ch jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mia'n tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' gu tukaa' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gu' tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix utu'ñ tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix búup va'k soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix maati'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't tɨbiap gu u'vɨ ka't.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan tu' mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kai' vaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; jano' ba' suudai' u'va kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va bakxidhat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu bɨx bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kai' vaas jix maa tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bakxidhat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Noemi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ cham tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Boos jix tɨ'ɨ ki'ñgob jix daa; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mii' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu Boos tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xanoop; jano' ba' suudai' u'va jix daa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ daraa kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix dhadhaa.

Ba' jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Moab bi'iix baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk gu Elimelek.

Jano' ba' tu' ja'xñi guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maachim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan daraa gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' mi' dhɨr tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Boos; gio ba' gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu novɨ gu Noemi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio gu Rut gu Moabita gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' jix koi bhaan gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu maa'nkar; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix duu na gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ duiñchu'; gio ba' dhi' ka't chuut gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu Boos; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Boos daraa bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix bɨɨx duu gu Elimelek bɨx ka't gu Kelioon gu Maaloon gu novɨ gu Noemi.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Rut gu Moabita gu u'vɨ gu Maaloon na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu maa'nkar na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix koi cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ki'ñgob pai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gui'p bɨx gu ja'tkam mi'p ki'ñgob bɨɨx daraa; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'vɨ ba'k gu vaak na ja'p gu Rakêl gu Leea gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Israeel; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Eprata guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Bet-leem.

Jano' ba' gu kai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu vaak na ja'p gu vaak gu Pares guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Tamar gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Boos jix bhɨɨ gu Rut ka't gu u'vɨ; gio ba' chɨbiapui gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ am:―Ja'pji gu Noemi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duu cham tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jir bɨx bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kɨɨv gu ma'nkam tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Noemi gu mar jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bham gu Noemi tu' maaxir gu mar jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Obed; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu taat gu Isaii gu taat gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Pares; gio ba' jix duu jix mar gu esroon.
Jano' ba' gu esroon jix mar gu Ram jix mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' gu Aminadab jix mar gu Naasoon jix mar gu Salmoon.
Jano' ba' gu Salmoon jix mar gu Boos jix mar gu Obed.
Jano' ba' gu Obed jix mar gu Isaii tu' gu Isaii jix mar gu Dabii.
